stop_claims.stop_reason: Cartilage: control n=3 but every exercise arm (S1, S4, S24, R24) has n=2 pooled replicates, so no planned comparison has >= 3 per arm; the suitability report fails sample_size (not_analyzable), which the decision contract treats as a hard stop. The paper still ran iDEP DESeq2 at n=2. A third replicate per arm, or a contract rule allowing an exploratory n=2 vs n=3 contrast, would unblock it.
